page.layout: Top: running head "PROMPTV. ICONVM" with page number at the top left; two round medallion portraits, left and right, each with legend printed around its rim. Below them, one column of text with two paragraphs, each beginning with capitalised words. No notes in the margins, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.l: PETR. BEMBVS. CARDI. AN. AGENS. LXXXVIII[?]
PAVL. IOVI
VS. COMENSIS
PETRVS Bembus Venetus Cardinalis, vir doctissimus,
& eloquentiæ Ciceronianæ summus imitator fuit, vt videre li-
cet ex eius scriptis prope infinitis, summa eruditione, sale & iu-
cunditate ita conspersis, vt ad ea perlegenda lectores alliciantur:
tanta vis est eius orationis. Scripsit opuscula aliquot impressa
Lugduni: Epistolas, De imitatione sermonis lib. 1. cum Ioannis
Francisci Pici, quibusdam opusculis: Poëma heroïcum, cum va-
riis poëmatis: de Aetna, libellũ: Historiæ Venetæ libros duode-
cim. Scripsit etiā elegantissimè de Culice, vt refert Nicolaus Ery-
threus, & multa alia. Claruit anno reparatæ salutis humanæ 1540.
PAVLVS Iouius Nouocomēsis Episcopus Nucerinus ad
vivum sic exprimitur, quod ad corporis delineationem sive de-
corā effigiē attinet: eius animus admirabilis cuivis innotescit, q;
eius historias incredibili facūdia & gravitate scriptas plegerit.
Constat hunc medicum fuisse, medicinámque exercuisse ante-
quam Episcopatus amplissimum gradum attigisset. Scripsit de
Romanis piscibus libellum: de vita Iacobi Muti, Attedulæ, Cot-
tig-nolæ, Sforciæ &c. librum impressum Basileæ: de rebus Turci-
cis: vitas omnium Turcicorum imperatorum: item de ordine ac
militia Turcicæ militiæ: vitas duodecim Vicecomitum Medio-
lani principum: vitam Leonis x. Pontif. Max. & Adriani, Pom-
pei Columnę Cardinalis, & infinita alia. Florebat tempore ma-
gni huius Cosmi Medicæi.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are printed around the portraits and are given as lines above the text. The left legend's last numeral is partly worn. The page number is faint at the top left. The word "Nouocomēsis" has a doubtful macron. Several words have printed hyphens at line ends, kept as printed. The text is clear otherwise.
